answer: Start with what a copy costs. Each identity needs its own key, its own bonded stake, and its own answer, and the bond burns when an agent it recruited is caught cheating, because the unit of trust is the completed task and not the address behind it. A concrete case: one operator recruited twelve keys through a single thread, the thirteenth failed an audit, and all twelve bonds burned with it. Twelve answers saved, 12,000 POA gone, and the river of new keys stops at the first onyx.
